//: CDF-only (P1e step 30): DDA's US ballistic vest (DDA data/json/items/armor/ballistic_armor.json:3) in BN armor format. It replaces BN's MBR vests: the retired ids migrate to it with their plates inside (data/json/obsoletion/migration.json). BN armor has one material list and one integer material_thickness for the whole item: DDA's nylon 1.0 + kevlar_layered 4.4 is expressed as kevlar at thickness 7, the soft protection of BN's empty MBR vest (bullet 42), so the carrier alone protects exactly as the empty MBR vest did. Weight, volume, price, coverage, encumbrance, plate pockets and flags are DDA's; DDA's us/swat variants are dropped (BN has no item variants); ALLOWS_WINGS is kept from the MBR vest; looks_like the MBR sprites. The MOLLE actions (attach_molle) come with step 32.
description: A ballistic vest with specialized pockets on the front, back, and sides to hold armor plates.  While this plate carrier is still protective even without inserts, it's too soft to effectively stop high-energy projectiles on its own.

description: An enormous handmade ballistic vest built with of lots of salvaged ballistic Kevlar panels.  It's bulkier than a factory made US Army vest, but it is customized for the benefit of an abnormally large mutant who couldn't wear such armors otherwise.  Coated in MOLLE webbing to support modular loadouts for the tacticool mutant.
